# Supply schedule

## Deliveries

Winter supplies arrive on the third Tuesday of each month by the cutter Gannet.
In summer the Gannet comes every second Tuesday instead, because the visitors
eat more than the keepers do.

## Ordering

Lamp oil is ordered by the first Friday of the month. Orders go to the
cooperative office in a sealed envelope, never by radio, so that nobody has to
repeat a quantity over a bad connection.

## Storage

Perishables go in the cold store, never in the tower. The tower stairs are
damp and the cheese does not forgive it.
